Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood marketplace & procurement path — next steps

Hi Bryan + Eve — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so procurement has clarity on the commercial paths: 

Summary of options we discussed:
- Credit card (direct, fastest): immediate access to hosted API, standard terms, monthly invoices.
- Purchase order (PO) / direct invoicing: Redwood can accept PO with net-30 (or custom term) under our MSA; procurement will need invoice contact + W-9.
- Cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure): we can go via the public marketplace listing or a private/partner offer. Marketplace provides consolidated billing through your cloud bill but can add ~5-10% on list price depending on marketplace fees; timing depends on listing vs private offer.

Attachments I’m sharing: redwood-MSA-v3.pdf (preview) and a one-page pricing sheet for the LumenAI pilot (pricing-sheet-LUM-2026-042.xlsx).

Questions / next asks:
1) Can you confirm which procurement path you prefer for the pilot (card vs PO vs marketplace)?
2) If PO, please share the procurement contact + billing address and any PO template we should expect.
3) If marketplace, do you have a preferred cloud provider (AWS / Azure / GCP) and do you need Redwood to pursue a private offer vs public listing?

Proposed next steps:
- If procurement prefers PO: introduce procurement (procurement@lumenai.com) to me and I’ll loop finance/legal to get the MSA and W-9 in place.
- If marketplace: we can introduce you to our marketplace ops lead and outline timeline — typically a private offer can be faster if you need consolidated billing.

I’ve CC’d Marissa (sales lead) and Rafael (contracts) to keep them in the loop. Happy to set a 30-min follow-up with procurement next week if that helps.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-MSA-v3.pdf (preview), pricing-sheet-LUM-2026-042.xlsx

Thanks Camila — good recap. For LumenAI’s procurement team, our preference is usually Azure Marketplace or direct PO depending on the vendor. A few notes from procurement: 

- Preferred: Azure Marketplace private/ISV offer (consolidated billing through our Azure tenant). If Redwood can support a private offer or listing, procurement will route payment via our Azure billing.
- Alternative: direct PO to Redwood with net-30 is acceptable for pilots.
- Marketplace concerns: pricing on the marketplace needs to match what procurement expects (we’ll need a marketplace price that aligns with the quote).

I’m looping procurement@lumenai.com for them to confirm timelines and required docs. They’ll need a short list of what Redwood needs to complete a private offer (reseller ID, marketplace listing stub, and contact for commercial terms).

Hi procurement team (thanks for jumping in) — quick note on each path and the specific items we’ll need so your procurement and finance teams can evaluate the quickest route: 

1) Direct PO (recommended if you want to avoid marketplace fees and complete quickly):
   - Redwood will sign the MSA (attached) and accept a PO referencing the deal ID LUM-2026-042.
   - We’ll need: PO document, billing address, remit-to details, and purchase order contact.
   - Redwood finance (cc’d: priyom_das@redwood.ai) can intake the PO and issue invoices on net-30 terms.

2) Azure Marketplace (preferred by LumenAI per Eve):
   - Two options: public listing or private offer (private offer is usually faster for pilots and allows custom pricing).
   - Marketplace path items: Redwood reseller/partner ID, price file that matches the quote, and a contact for marketplace operations.
   - Timeline: public listing 6-8 weeks typical; private offer can be completed in ~2-4 weeks depending on cloud partner approvals.

3) Card (fastest for immediate access):
   - If you want to start immediately, we can put the pilot on a credit card and then transition to PO/marketplace mid-pilot.

I’ve attached the preview MSA and the pricing sheet. For convenience I’ve also created a DocuSign preview of the MSA: https://app.docusign.com/1234-abcd — feel free to forward that to your procurement/legal.

Next steps I suggest:
- Procurement to confirm preferred path (PO vs Azure private offer vs card).
- If PO: procurement shares PO template or issue PO and we’ll route to priyom for processing.
- If marketplace: please introduce a marketplace ops/contact and we’ll schedule a short intake call with our partner ops.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement this week to speed things up — what time works?

Best,
